name: CSV Writer
description: Writes the input table to a delimited text file. The input table is passed through unchanged.

file.title: Output file
file.description: Absolute path of the CSV file to write; parent directories are created.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Field separator written to the file; a comma by default.

header.title: Header row
header.description: Whether to write column names as the first row.
